//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Skeleton Horse Spawn -> Config

Enable Skeleton Horse Spawn.//: Whether Skeleton Horse Spawn is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

chanceSurfaceSkeletonHasHorse.//: The chance a skeleton that has spawned on the surface is riding a horse.

shouldBurnSkeletonHorsesInDaylight.//: If enabled, burns skeleton horses when daylight shines upon them.

onlySpawnSkeletonHorsesOnSurface.//: If enabled, a skeleton horse with rider will only spawn on the surface.
